quote: using estimates of per-step correctness obtained from running Monte Carlo rollouts from each step in the solution
reason: A step-level verifier is trained by "using estimates of per-step correctness obtained from running Monte Carlo rollouts from each step in the solution" [@snell2024], so any prefix can be resampled; tree search over partial solutions branches the same way [@yao2023a].

quote: real-world agents only have one chance to serve the user
reason: Real agents face a user who gets one attempt: "real-world agents only have one chance to serve the user" [@yao2024]; this supports no restart, not the cell's 'one turn, then human'.
note: The passage supports side effects without a restart. yao2024 describes an episode as a multi-call conversation (c6), not one tool call then a human turn, so the value as worded is not supported.

quote: contrary to human players, the agent does not have the option to reset the game when stuck
reason: In deployment-like settings "contrary to human players, the agent does not have the option to reset the game when stuck" [@grinsztajn2021]; so a run has no reset [@kwa2025; @sharma2022].
note: Supports 'no reset' only, in a game RL setting. Hundreds of calls, hours and step cap are not quoted.
